motivation: v0.65 found a persistent negative sigma8 response over the tested tangent-amplitude and redshift grid but failed its stronger finite-amplitude convergence gate at 3 of 7 primary redshifts. v0.66 does not alter or reinterpret that FAIL. Instead it tests a separate linear-theory identity: because the eta=0 variational source enters a linear perturbation system additively, each matter transfer mode is affine in the numerical tangent amplification lambda, while sigma8^2 is therefore exactly quadratic in lambda. A symmetric difference of sigma8^2 isolates the eta=0 tangent coefficient without a lambda-to-zero extrapolation. The same coefficient is reconstructed as a signed k-space kernel to identify the scales that generate the growth response.

source_results.known_v065_sign_result: R_sigma(lambda,z)<0 for all four tested lambda values and all seven primary redshifts; extrapolated R0(z)<0 at all seven primary redshifts.
source_results.known_v065_failure_mode: The preregistered stabilization inequality passed at 4 of 7 primary redshifts instead of the required 6 of 7.
source_results.policy: v0.66 is a new post-v0.65 theory test. It must not be described as retroactively converting the v0.65 FAIL into a PASS.

theory_identity.transfer_affinity: For every linear matter transfer mode D(k,z;lambda)=D0(k,z)+lambda D1(k,z).
theory_identity.exact_tangent_estimator: R_exact(lambda,z)=[sigma8^2(+lambda,z)-sigma8^2(-lambda,z)]/[4 lambda sigma8^2(0,z)]=B(z)/A(z)=d ln sigma8/d eta at eta=0 in exact arithmetic.
theory_identity.reason_no_lambda_extrapolation_is_needed: The lambda^2 term cancels identically in the symmetric difference of sigma8^2.
theory_identity.memory_entry_point: At eta=0 the variational memory perturbation enters only as the additive E-equation source dE'/deta|0=-a Q Bchi_raw/(2 KB); the memory patch has no background correction and no direct linear Einstein stress.
theory_identity.causal_chain_to_test: memory tangent source -> E and alpha -> Pi_aest and dark density/velocity -> metric response -> total matter transfer -> sigma8

k_kernel.definition: K(k,z)=0.5 I0(k,z) [d ln Pm(k,z)/d eta]/sigma8^2(z), with I0=k^3 P0 W_TH^2(k R8)/(2 pi^2), so integral K d ln k = d ln sigma8/d eta.
k_kernel.bin_policy: Report the signed contribution to d ln sigma8/d eta and the fraction of the absolute kernel in every fixed bin. Do not select bins after seeing the result.

secondary_reports_no_gate: signed k-bin contributions at every primary and context redshift
fraction of absolute k-kernel in every fixed bin
location of the largest absolute kernel density at each redshift
d ln Pm/d eta on the fixed k grid

classification_policy.meaning: PASS certifies a data-blind linear-theory tangent identity and a negative exact growth derivative on the frozen model. It is not an observational detection and does not change the historical v0.65 classification.

anti_tuning: After this predata file is committed, do not change the frozen cosmology, KB, tauH0, p, CLASS commit, lambda set, redshift sets, k-grid bounds/resolution, fixed k bins, exact sigma8-squared estimator, kernel definition, or numerical gates after reading v0.66 results. A FAIL is retained.
